$description: Closed assetRole enum, wired through schema/pagespec.schema.json's visual field definitions and every section/component that carries a visual field (see the sections/*.json assetRoles array for which role each section is allowed to use). Heidi Health is a real, live commercial healthcare company -- every role below carries explicit AI-generation and licensing guidance; this is a compliance requirement, not a style note.

third-party-logo.description: Real EMR/partner/customer wordmark logos (e.g. public/assets/home/logo-0..9.svg, public/assets/pages/*emishealth*, *medicushealth*, *medioffice*).
third-party-logo.licensing: These are real third-party companies' registered trademarks/logos, sourced from the live site's own asset CDN. An AI generator must NEVER fabricate a new company logo under this role, and must never reproduce, redraw, or recolor a captured logo outside the exact asset reference the PageSpec already points at. Do not use this role to invent a new, unlisted partner.

customer-photo.description: Real named customer/clinician headshots accompanying a testimonial quote.
customer-photo.licensing: These are real people's photographs. An AI generator must never fabricate a synthetic headshot and attach it to a real name/quote, and must never reuse a real captured photo for a different (invented) name/quote. If no real photo is available for a generated testimonial, the visual field must be omitted, not synthesized.

heidi-brand-mark.licensing: Heidi Health's own registered trademark. Must be reused byte-for-byte from the existing asset reference; never redrawn, recolored, or approximated by a generative image model.

illustrative-photo.description: Generic lifestyle/product-context photography (hero visuals, feature-row imagery) that does not depict a real, identifiable person or proprietary UI.
illustrative-photo.licensing: Safe for AI-generated replacement art as long as it does not depict a real, identifiable clinician/patient or reproduce Heidi's real product UI verbatim.

proprietary-product-screenshot.description: Real screenshots of the Heidi product UI (e.g. band.shot-panel).
proprietary-product-screenshot.licensing: Real proprietary product UI. Must not be recreated by a generative model even approximately (no 'looks like a note-taking app' substitute) -- reuse the exact captured screenshot reference or omit the field.

editorial-thumbnail.licensing: Generic editorial imagery may be AI-generated for new cards, provided it does not depict a real identifiable person or reproduce a real screenshot/logo.

editorial-diagram.description: Technical/architecture diagram imagery (e.g. band.diagram-band on the hardware page).
editorial-diagram.licensing: May be AI-generated as a generic illustrative diagram; must not reproduce a real proprietary system diagram verbatim.

product-demo-video.licensing: Real product-demo footage. Must reuse the exact captured video reference or be omitted; never synthesized.

compliance-badge.description: Real third-party compliance/certification badges (e.g. SOC2, HIPAA marks) shown in band.compliance-panel.
compliance-badge.licensing: Real certification marks issued by third-party bodies. Must never be fabricated or applied to a certification Heidi does not actually hold.
